d: The Csutomer Service Executive is responsible for driving short-term rental sales and building strong relationships with individual and corporate clients, including key Dollar accounts. This role serves as the primary point of contact at the rental counter, ensuring accurate transaction processing, maximizing sales and up-sell opportunities, and delivering a high standard of customer service in line with company policies and quality standards.
q: Minimum 2-3 years of experience in a customer-facing sales role, preferably within car rental, hospitality, retail, or a related service industry
Strong sales and negotiation skills with a demonstrated ability to meet or exceed targets
Proven ability to upsell and cross-sell products/services (protection options, upgrades, refueling packages, promotions) to maximize revenue per transaction
Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English; additional languages an advantage
High attention to detail, particularly in reviewing contracts, rates, and financial calculations
Sound judgment and problem-solving ability within defined empowerment guidelines
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage documentation, reporting, and reconciliation tasks accurately
Proficiency in relevant rental/reservation systems and MS Office applications
Customer-centric mindset with a professional, presentable demeanor in line with company uniform and quality standards
Ability to work flexible shifts, including weekends and holidays, as per operational requirements
r: Use company-approved sales and service techniques to determine customer needs and recommend suitable rental solutions
Sell services and offer optional products (protection options, refueling program, upgrades, special promotions, future reservations) to maximize sales opportunities and meet management-set targets
Maximize up-sells and walk-up sales based on vehicle availability, applying established sales techniques and dialogues
Provide customers with assistance such as directions, maps, local area information, and relevant service details
Coordinate and manage customers within the queue to minimize wait times and ensure efficient service delivery
Answer phone calls promptly and assist customers in a friendly, helpful manner
Handle email queries and respond to internal and external correspondence within agreed turnaround times
Prepare all rental documents accurately and completely
Complete rental transactions and agreements in accordance with established guidelines and procedures
Review rental parameters and qualify each customer against company rental requirement guidelines, ensuring full understanding of applicable rates and service charges
Prepare the Rental Agreement Folder with all required supporting information
Review completed contracts with customers to verify accuracy of information, rates, return dates, and charges, ensuring the rental agreement date and time are correct
Review all charges and complete transaction procedures for returned vehicles, verifying accuracy of closing calculations
Prepare daily key reports and car requirement schedules for the location in coordination with the Fleet Coordinator
Maintain and submit petty cash claims and fuel slips on a regular, periodic basis
Conduct regular follow-ups on overdue rentals, ensuring outstanding amounts are communicated to and charged to customers
Adhere to Company Quality Assurance standards and Uniform Guidelines
Resolve customer-raised issues using sound judgment within applied empowerment guidelines and company policy
Identify new business opportunities at the location and propose ideas to line managers/supervisors to support growth
Perform additional duties as directed by management or undertaken on personal initiative

d: We are seeking a highly motivated and results-driven Operations Manager to lead, optimize, and oversee end-to-end express delivery and hub operations. In this role, you will be responsible for ensuring seamless first-mile, sorting, transportation, and last-mile operations while driving service efficiency, maintaining safety compliance, and meeting operational KPIs.
q: Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, or a related field.
Experience: 3–5+ years of experience in express delivery, last-mile logistics, e-commerce operations, or supply chain management.
Leadership: Proven track record in managing large operational teams and multi-site hub operations.
Technical Skills: Proficiency in logistics management systems (WMS/TMS), MS Excel, and operational data analytics.
Key Soft Skills: Strong problem-solving abilities, high stress tolerance in a fast-paced environment, and clear stakeholder communication.
Language Requirements: Fluency in English (Hindi/Urdu or Arabic fluency is often preferred depending on the regional market).
r: Manage end-to-end logistics operations, including pickup, sorting, transportation, and last-mile parcel delivery.
Monitor daily branch/hub activities to ensure operational targets and service level agreements (SLAs) are met consistently.
Plan and optimize delivery routes and driver dispatch schedules to reduce transit times and operational costs.
Track and report on key operational metrics, such as On-Time Delivery (OTD), delivery success rate, and cost-per-parcel.
Drive process improvement initiatives to reduce parcel damage, missing rates, and customer complaints.
Conduct regular reviews of operational efficiency and present reports to senior management.
Lead, mentor, and manage supervisors, sorting staff, couriers, and fleet personnel.
Oversee manpower planning, shift schedules, peak-season resource allocation, and recruitment needs.
Foster a safe, high-performance, and accountable work environment.
Ensure full compliance with company SOPs, safety policies, and local labor/transportation regulations.
Enforce strict protocols around proof of delivery (POD), parcel handling, and inventory control.

d: Lead legal and contractual matters throughout the project lifecycle, from tendering and negotiation to financial close, implementation, operations, and compliance, protecting the Company's interests and ensuring effective risk management.
q: Strong expertise in infrastructure, PPP, EPC, concession, and O&M contracts.
Contract drafting, negotiation, project finance, and dispute resolution.
Knowledge of Saudi legislation, corporate governance, and regulatory compliance.
Strong negotiation, analytical, and commercial judgment.
Excellent communication, leadership, and stakeholder management.
Ability to work across multidisciplinary and international teams.
Bachelor's degree in Law; LL.M. advantageous.
Qualified legal professional with 12–15 years of relevant experience.
Proven experience in infrastructure projects from tendering through implementation and operations.
Water, wastewater, utilities, and Saudi PPP experience preferred.
r: Tendering & Development: Review RfQs, RfPs, project agreements, legal risks, qualifications, and contractual deviations.
Partnerships & Structuring: Draft and negotiate NDAs, MoUs, consortium, JV, shareholder, and SPV agreements.
Negotiation & Financial Close: Lead legal negotiations of PPP, BOT/BOOT, concession, EPC, O&M, and financing-related agreements.
Project Implementation: Support contract administration, variations, claims, disputes, contractual amendments, and risk mitigation.
Compliance & Governance: Ensure regulatory compliance, contractual obligations, corporate governance, and required approvals throughout the project lifecycle.
Legal Coordination: Manage external legal advisors and provide strategic legal advice to Management and project teams.
